name: Sichuan Peanut Noodles with Charred Chicken Thigh & Cucumber Salad
description: Charred chicken thighs marinated in soy and dry sherry, served over rich sesame-peanut noodles with a cold cucumber salad.
instructions: Marinate the chicken briefly with soy and dry sherry, then char until cooked through.
Whisk sesame paste, peanut butter, soy, black vinegar, sesame oil, garlic and a splash of noodle water into a glossy sauce.
Boil the noodles and toss through the sauce.
Slice and season the cucumber for the salad, then plate with sliced chicken, spring onion, sesame and Sichuan pepper.
